origin: it should NOT report when comment precedes the tag
source:
defmodule CredoSampleModuleTest do
  alias ExUnit.Case

  # Happy case: Some comment
  @tag :skip
  test "foo" do
    :ok
  end

  # Some comment
  @tag :skip
  # another comment, shouldn't matter
  test "foo2" do
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule CredoSampleModuleTest do
  alias ExUnit.Case

  @tag :skip
  test "foo" do
    :ok
  end
end

findings.message: Tests tagged to be skipped should have a comment preceding the `@tag :skip`.
